hero.title: BASE: Bridging AI, Systems, and Environment
hero.description: Advancing AI frontiers through innovative research in agriculture and beyond

carouselItems.title: Conference Presentation at CVPR 2026 in Denver, CO
carouselItems.description: PhD student Taminul Islam presented 'TRACE: Thermal Recognition Attentive-Framework for CO2 Emissions from Livestock' at the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026 in Denver, CO.

carouselItems.title: Oral Presentation at WACV 2026 in Tucson, AZ
carouselItems.description: PhD student Taminul Islam delivered an oral presentation of 'FUME: Fused Unified Multi-Gas Emission Network for Livestock Rumen Acidosis Detection' at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2026 in Tucson, AZ.

carouselItems.title: Highly Cited Paper 2024-2025: Detection and Classification of Cannabis Seeds
carouselItems.description: Our article 'Detection and Classification of Cannabis Seeds Using RetinaNet and Faster R-CNN' published in Seeds (MDPI) has been recognized as a Highly Cited Paper for 2024-2025.

carouselItems.title: WeedSense Poster Presentation at ICCV 2025
carouselItems.description: PhD student Toqi Tahamid Sarker presented WeedSense at the 10th Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture (CVPPA) workshop at ICCV 2025 in Honolulu, Hawaii.

carouselItems.title: GasTwinFormer Poster Presentation at ICCV 2025
carouselItems.description: PhD student Toqi Tahamid Sarker presented GasTwinFormer at the Sustainability with Earth Observation & AI (SEA) workshop at ICCV 2025 in Honolulu, Hawaii.

carouselItems.title: Conference Presentation at ISVC 2025: CarboFormer
carouselItems.description: Our team presented 'CarboFormer: A Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Architecture for Efficient Carbon Dioxide Detection Using Optical Gas Imaging' at the International Symposium on Visual Computing (ISVC) 2025.

carouselItems.title: Awarded at Illinois Young Innovator of the Year
carouselItems.description: PhD Student Taminul Islam has been awarded 3rd place in the 2025 Illinois Young Innovator of the Year, among 16 selective talks by Falling Walls Lab Illinois.

carouselItems.title: Conference Presentation at ICMLA 2024
carouselItems.description: PhD student Taminul Islam presented our research on weed growth stage classification and detection at the Deep Learning and Applications special session during the 23rd International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA).

carouselItems.title: Poster Presentation at IIN Sustainability Research Conference
carouselItems.description: Taminul Islam presented a poster on our research on weed growth stage classification and detection at the Illinois Innovation Network’s Sustainability Research Conference, held at Illinois State University.

carouselItems.title: Poster Presentation at 5th Annual Hemp Cannabis Symposium 2024
carouselItems.description: Our team presented research on detecting and classifying cannabis seeds using deep learning techniques.

carouselItems.title: BASE Lab at the Graduate School Fair 2024
carouselItems.description: PhD students Toqi and Taminul, along with Dr. Khaled, represented the BASE Lab and the School of Computing at the Graduate School Fair 2024 at Southern Illinois University Carbondale.

researchFocusAreas.title: Computer Vision
researchFocusAreas.description: Developing advanced techniques for visual data interpretation, including object detection, recognition, and image processing, to enhance automated visual understanding in diverse applications.

researchFocusAreas.title: Deep Learning
researchFocusAreas.description: Designing and optimizing state-of-the-art neural network architectures and algorithms to address complex problems across various domains, with a focus on improving performance and scalability.

researchFocusAreas.title: AI for Agriculture
researchFocusAreas.description: Applying artificial intelligence to agricultural challenges such as precision livestock management, crop health monitoring, and yield prediction, aiming to improve efficiency and sustainability in agriculture.

researchFocusAreas.title: Federated Learning
researchFocusAreas.description: Creating robust federated learning frameworks to handle non-iid data and resource constraints, ensuring effective and secure distributed learning across heterogeneous environments.
